LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 10.3.1 CONJUNCTIONS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.3: Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Conjunctions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Conjunctions. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do you join two or more sentences?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify conjunctions in a text
2. use conjunctions correctly in varied contexts

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify conjunctions in a text
   In simple words: practise until you can identify conjunctions in a text. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. use conjunctions correctly in varied contexts
   In simple words: practise until you can use conjunctions correctly in varied contexts. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Conjunctions using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Conjunctions in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Conjunctions to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Conjunctions.
4. Show that you can: identify conjunctions in a text

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Conjunctions using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Conjunctions important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Construct sentences on proper use of leisure time using conjunctions,
2. Fill in blanks in sentences using conjunctions,
3. Collaborate with peers to construct sentences using conjunctions,
4. Life Skills (Effective Communication): The learner develops better communication skills through correct use of conjunctions.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify conjunctions in a text
2. use conjunctions correctly in varied contexts

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
